response.overview: The kings of speed are so often the kings of crash... and most spectacular of all are the motorcycle racers. There’s no doubt about it - when it comes to crashing - the bikers do it better!  Wherever motorcyclists race, they crash. Whether it’s the World Championship Grand Prix series, the Isle of Man TT, America’s National Championships or the red-hot world of Cross-Country Desert Racing. We’ve taken the very best footage from all of these major championships to show that it’s not just the turkeys who get plucked! The best of the racers are often the best of the crashers... and here’s the evidence to prove it!  Ladies and gentlemen, we give you... the Crash Kings!  Judge for yourself which of the stars of these 150+ incidents is the true ‘Crash Kings of Bikes’!  The majority of the incidents seen in this programme have not been used in any other crash videos. No serious injury or fatal accidents are featured.
response.title: Crash Kings Bikes
